title: The Entertainment
description: The Entertainment Center in imperial City on Coruscant, the galactic seat of government (front), as envisioned in a new painting by Ralph McQuarrie for the book, THE ILLUSTRATED STAR WARS UNIVERSE. Will Coruscant, which appeared in an early draft of the script for RETURN OF THE JEDI, appear in the next trilogy? Stay tuned! McQuarrie also designed the tattooed lady (back) as a possible resident of Bespin's Cloud City.
